R1.description: A pull request whose every changed path is documentation is detected by a pure classifier over a fixed documentation set that no test outside the documentation gate reads, failing closed to code on any doubt, with a guard test over the set

R2.description: validate.yml gains a changes job and a docs gate job, skips plan and the shards for a documentation-only pull request, and tests-result still succeeds only when changes and the gate succeeded and fails closed otherwise, with no workflow-level path filter and main unchanged

R3.description: The guides describe the jobs, the documentation set, the fail-closed rules and the local documentation gate
